culprit_citations.quoted_text: 15484880 Canada Inc. and 15484910 Canada Inc. continuation row: Senior subordinated loan | 14.00 % PIK | 04/2025 | 04/2035 | fair value 14.7

findings.detail: The senior subordinated loan has a source coupon of 14.00% PIK, but the extracted PRIVATE_CREDIT row stores blank interest_rate and no basis_spread.

rationale: Class 2 row-validation issue. The bundle flags PRIVATE_CREDIT rows with blank interest_rate/basis_spread. For 15484880 Canada Inc. and 15484910 Canada Inc., the raw SOI continuation row for the senior subordinated loan explicitly reports coupon 14.00 % PIK, while the reviewed extracted row has interest_rate blank. The source therefore contains rate data that the extraction omitted.
